name: plasma-grid
title: Plasma Grid
description: Animated plasma grid effect rendered in WebGL. Creates a checkerboard grid pattern with flowing plasma noise gradients. Colors are customizable via props. Lit Custom Element.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/plasma-grid-element.ts";
---

<motion-plasma-grid
  color="#17181A"
  highlight-color="#FF6900"
  speed={0.5}
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/plasma-grid-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-plasma-grid
    color="#17181A"
    highlight-color="#FF6900"
    :speed="0.5"
    class="w-full h-[500px]"
  />
</template>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/plasma-grid-element.js"></script>

<motion-plasma-grid
  color="#17181A"
  highlight-color="#FF6900"
  speed="0.5"
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

props.name: color
props.description: The base background color of the effect.

props.name: highlight-color
props.description: The color used for the plasma noise gradients.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier. Higher values make the plasma flow faster.
